text: {"name":"bt_conn_start_proc","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Validates a BT connection entry, fills its 48-byte pending-command sub-slot with link-layer procedure parameters (opcode, flags, timeout, context), arms a tick timeout via ke_event_lock, sets the pending-active flag, and advances the connection state machine.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v7":"conn_table_base","v8":"conn_idx","v9":"conn_entry","v10":"proc_type","v11":"conn_entry2","v13":"lock_target","v14":"pending_slot","v17":"cmd_sub_entry","v18":"seq_counter","v21":"conn_idx_x140"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":16,"meaning":"pending_proc_type or active_flag (byte at conn+16)"},{"offset":64,"meaning":"busy/conflict guard byte (non-zero blocks new proc)"},{"offset":112,"meaning":"entry_valid or allocated flag (must be 1)"},{"offset":113,"meaning":"flag_byte with set_flag_byte mask 3"},{"offset":121,"meaning":"seq or retry counter byte"},{"offset":122,"meaning":"proc_count or pending_count byte"}]}
